briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race intensifies with multi-agent breakthroughs

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid surging investment. Prompt injection attacks continue to dominate real-world exploits as adoption scales.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with enhanced reasoning; Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus; xAI Grok-3 and DeepSeek-V3 show strong benchmark gains.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 2M units; Microsoft and Google announce new 100k GPU clusters in Texas and Iowa.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems reach autonomous goal pursuit before 2027 safety standards are finalized?
